description: This Java class defines an internal REST API resource for internal classifications of COB (Close of Business) operations related to loans within the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints for retrieving COB partitions and updating loan COB dates, primarily used for testing purposes under a specific Spring profile.

classes.name: InternalCOBApiResource
classes.description: A Spring component that provides internal API endpoints for COB operations, primarily for testing purposes, including retrieving COB partitions and updating loan COB dates.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization callback that logs warnings not to use this in production.

methods.name: getCobPartitions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve COB partition information for a specified partition size.

methods.name: updateLoanCobLastDate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the last closed business date for a specific loan.

methods.name: loanReprocess
methods.description: Handles POST requests to trigger reprocessing of transactions for a specified loan.
